observation.summary: Simulation.arrive increments persistent arrival statistics before confirming a legal spawn point, so a failed arrival mutates history.

evidence.statement: stats.arrivals is post-incremented before nav.free is checked, and the method can return false immediately afterward.

hypothesis.cause: The arrival counter is committed before the final fallible spawn precondition.
hypothesis.prediction: Moving the counter increment after spawn validation leaves failed arrivals side-effect free while successful arrivals retain monotonic numbering.
hypothesis.falsifier: A failed spawn still changes arrivals, or successful arrival naming/statistics regress.

candidates.reason: Preserves existing flow and commits persistent history only after the fallible boundary passes.
Adds compensating mutation where ordering alone can preserve atomicity.

implementation.summary: Delay arrival counter mutation until a valid spawn exists and add regression coverage inside an existing test case.

before.summary: A forced nav.free failure increments stats.arrivals despite returning false.

limitations: Covers arrival state atomicity only; no browser/player-experience claim.

next: Inspect one separate village invariant after merge.
